subject: English
question_text: A dialogue between two friends on the bad effects of smoking.
stimulus: Subject Code : (i) excited (ii) agitated (iii) active (iv) docile (d) What does the expression "So it is most valuable thing" mean? (i) Time is most precious. (ii) Time is changeable. (iii) Time is factor. (iv) Time is abiding. (e) Which of the following statement is true about an unpunctual man? (i) He prospers in life. (ii) He stumbles. (iii) He puts of things. (iv) He carries on his duties. (f) "This has to be remedied if we are to keep with the modern world." What does it mean? (i) We should be active. (ii) We are to shun of the bad habit of unpunctuality. (iii) We should be prompt. (iv) We should be agile. (g) What is the main theme of the passage? (i) The passage deals with punctuality. (ii) The passage is a discussion on the sufferings of an unpunctual man. (iii) The passage put emphasis on punctuality. (iv) The passage tells about timely action.
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue about the danger of smoking. See Ideal School & College, Motijheel, Dhaka. Sl. No. 14; Page No. 60 (a) An unpunctual officer upsets the day's programme not only of his ownself but also of those who have dealings with him. (b) By punctuality as stated in the passage I mean keeping time to the appointed or fixed hour. (c) Nothing can stop the flow of time. Time once lost is lost forever. Lost money can be gained by hard labour. But lost time can never be gained. So it is the most valuable thing. (d) Yes, of course. Punctuality is such an asset of human being that rewards anybody to succeed in life. The 166 essence of punctuality stimulates the Western people to succeed in life. (e) An unpunctual student misses a part of the lesson and causes disturbance to others. An unpunctual officer upsets both his and others job.
